The '''Colonial Era''' was the period where the first settlers to the Tapani sector came to the planet [[Pelagon]] around [[13,000 BBY]] in huge colony ships sent from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. Beneath the oceans of Pelagon there were ancient ruins that pre-dated the arrival of the colonists.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> During this period the sector was at the extreme of [[Human/Legends|Human]] exploration of the galaxy and the early colonists of Pelagon were quite isolated. These original colonists controlled several other systems that were under [[House Calipsa|Calipsa's]] control during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" /> Most of these systems were rich in ore but were not as easily settled.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" /> Fortunately, the region had an abundance of inhabitable worlds and it did not take long for the settlers to migrate out from Pelagon and prosper.<ref name="Player's Guide to Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>

The colonies were initially governed by the [[Pella Compact]], the council that led the colony ships to Pelagon from the Core.<ref name="Player's Guide to Tapani" /> Its leaders established the first alliances with the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] and established the first trade routes in the region.<ref name="Player's Guide to Tapani" />
